g.text: 06 / Barrel and USB-C PD power inputs

g.desc: 06 / Barrel and USB-C PD power inputs

g.text: Center-positive barrel input: 9-25 V DC. USB-C requires a 20 V / 3 A PD supply; its data contacts are unconnected.

g.desc: Center-positive barrel input: 9-25 V DC. USB-C requires a 20 V / 3 A PD supply; its data contacts are unconnected.

g.text: Schottky source OR-ing prevents reverse feed. The highest source normally supplies the load; seamless changeover is not guaranteed.
